# E2E Test Plan: User Registration Flow

**Task ID:** mn9ssmyn-qu65rc  
**Date:** 2026-03-28  
**Author:** QA Engineer  

---

## Scope

End-to-end testing of the user registration flow covering:

1. Email Validation
2. Password Strength
3. Duplicate Account Check
4. Email Verification
5. Account Activation

**Preconditions:** A running instance of the application with SMTP/email service configured.

---

## 1. Email Validation

| # | Test Case | Steps | Expected Result |
|---|-----------|-------|-----------------|
| 1.1 | Valid email accepted | Enter a valid email (e.g. `user@example.com`) | Email field shows no error; form proceeds |
| 1.2 | Missing `@` symbol | Enter `userexample.com` | Inline error: "Invalid email format" |
| 1.3 | Missing domain | Enter `user@` | Inline error: "Invalid email format" |
| 1.4 | Missing local part | Enter `@example.com` | Inline error: "Invalid email format" |
| 1.5 | Trailing/leading whitespace | Enter ` user@example.com ` | Whitespace trimmed; accepted as valid |
| 1.6 | Invalid characters in local part | Enter `user name@example.com` | Inline error: "Invalid email format" |
| 1.7 | Empty email field | Leave blank and submit | Inline error: "Email is required" |
| 1.8 | Disposable/temp email domain | Enter `user@tempmail.com` (or known disposable domain) | Rejected with "Please use a permanent email address" (if policy enforced) |

## 2. Password Strength

| # | Test Case | Steps | Expected Result |
|---|-----------|-------|-----------------|
| 2.1 | Strong password | Enter `Str0ng!Pass#2026` | Strength meter shows "Strong"; no warnings |
| 2.2 | Too short (< 8 chars) | Enter `Ab1!` | Error: "Password must be at least 8 characters" |
| 2.3 | No uppercase | Enter `str0ng!pass` | Warning: "Include at least one uppercase letter" |
| 2.4 | No lowercase | Enter `STR0NG!PASS` | Warning: "Include at least one lowercase letter" |
| 2.5 | No number | Enter `Strong!Pass` | Warning: "Include at least one number" |
| 2.6 | No special character | Enter `StrongPass2026` | Warning: "Include at least one special character" |
| 2.7 | Common/breached password | Enter `Password123` | Warning: "This password has been found in data breaches" (if breach check enabled) |
| 2.8 | Password == email | Enter password same as email | Error: "Password must not match your email" |
| 2.9 | Password == username | Enter password same as username | Error: "Password must not match your username" |
| 2.10 | Empty password | Leave blank and submit | Error: "Password is required" |
| 2.11 | Password and confirm mismatch | Enter different values in password/confirm fields | Error: "Passwords do not match" |

## 3. Duplicate Account Check

| # | Test Case | Steps | Expected Result |
|---|-----------|-------|-----------------|
| 3.1 | New unique email | Register with an email not in the system | Account created successfully |
| 3.2 | Already registered email | Register with an existing email | Error: "An account with this email already exists" |
| 3.3 | Case-insensitive duplicate | Register with existing email but different case (`USER@example.com`) | Error: "An account with this email already exists" |
| 3.4 | Duplicate check timing | Submit form rapidly twice with same email | Second submission returns duplicate error (no race condition / duplicate account) |
| 3.5 | Previously deleted account email | Register with email of a soft-deleted account | Behavior depends on policy — either reactivates or rejects with specific message |

## 4. Email Verification

| # | Test Case | Steps | Expected Result |
|---|-----------|-------|-----------------|
| 4.1 | Verification email sent | Complete registration with valid data | Verification email arrives within 60s; contains link/token |
| 4.2 | Valid verification link | Click the verification link from email | Account marked as verified; redirected to login/success page |
| 4.3 | Expired verification link | Wait until token expires, then click link | Error: "Verification link has expired" with option to resend |
| 4.4 | Invalid/tampered token | Modify the token in the URL and visit | Error: "Invalid verification link" |
| 4.5 | Resend verification email | Click "Resend verification" | New email sent; old token invalidated |
| 4.6 | Already verified account | Click verification link for already-verified account | Message: "Account already verified" or redirect to login |
| 4.7 | Email not received (spam) | Check spam/junk folder | Verification email should pass SPF/DKIM/DMARC checks (infra concern) |
| 4.8 | Verification before registration submit | Visit verification endpoint without registering | Error: "Invalid or expired link" |
| 4.9 | Rate limit on resend | Click "Resend" multiple times rapidly | After N attempts: "Please wait X seconds before requesting another email" |

## 5. Account Activation

| # | Test Case | Steps | Expected Result |
|---|-----------|-------|-----------------|
| 5.1 | Login after verification | Verify email, then log in with credentials | Login succeeds; user can access authenticated pages |
| 5.2 | Login before verification | Attempt to log in with unverified email | Error: "Please verify your email before logging in" (or login allowed with limited access, depending on policy) |
| 5.3 | Admin manual activation | Admin activates a pending account | User receives notification; can now log in |
| 5.4 | Account locked after failed verification timeout | Wait beyond verification deadline | Account marked inactive; "Resend verification" option available |
| 5.5 | Re-registration after expiration | Attempt to register again with expired unverified email | Either re-sends verification or requires new registration depending on policy |

---

## Cross-Cutting Concerns

| # | Area | Test Case | Expected Result |
|---|------|-----------|-----------------|
| C1 | Security | SQL injection in email field | Input sanitized; no DB error exposed |
| C2 | Security | XSS in username/email fields | Input escaped or sanitized in stored/displayed output |
| C3 | Localization | Form in non-English locale | All validation messages translated correctly |
| C4 | Accessibility | Tab through form fields | Logical focus order; all errors announced by screen readers |
| C5 | Mobile | Complete registration on mobile viewport | Form responsive; all validation works on touch |
| C6 | Performance | Page load time for registration form | < 2s on 3G connection |
| C7 | API | Direct API calls bypassing UI | Same validation enforced server-side |

---

## Test Environment

- **Browser matrix:** Chrome (latest), Firefox (latest), Safari (latest), Mobile Safari, Chrome Android
- **Email service:** Test mailhog or similar local SMTP trap
- **Test data:** Unique email per test run; seeded test accounts for duplicate checks
- **Automation recommendation:** Playwright or Cypress for cross-browser E2E

---

## Entry / Exit Criteria

- **Entry:** Registration page is accessible and email service is operational
- **Exit:** All test cases pass; no critical/high bugs open; automated tests added to CI pipeline

content.text:
The E2E test plan is ready at **`docs/e2e-test-plan-registration.md`**. It covers:

- **Email Validation** — 8 cases (format, whitespace, empty, disposable domains)
- **Password Strength** — 11 cases (length, complexity, breach check, confirm mismatch)
- **Duplicate Account Check** — 5 cases (exact, case-insensitive, race condition, soft-deleted)
- **Email Verification** — 9 cases (send, valid/invalid/expired links, resend, rate limit)
- **Account Activation** — 5 cases (login before/after verification, admin activation, expiration)
- **Cross-Cutting Concerns** — 7 cases (SQLi, XSS, a11y, mobile, API bypass, performance, i18n)

Each case includes steps and expected results. Ready for the developer to implement against or for automation scripting.
